newsitem.title: USA: Marks Bros. to open 30 stores in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Marks Bros. to open 30 stores in 1997.

text.p: Marks Bros. Jewelers Inc said Friday it is accelerating its new store expansion plan for 1997, and expects to open 30 new stores in 1997, up from 28 units as originally planned.
Marks Bros. currently operates 172 stores in 24 states.

"We are accelerating our new store expansion plan to take advantage of our strong new store economics and favorable demographics in the retail jewelry marketplace," Hugh Patinkin, chairman, said in a statement. "Our ability to obtain prime locations from other jewelers on favorable terms enables us to participate in the continuing consolidation of the highly fragmented jewelry industry."
